query: OpenAI, Anthropic, and Mistral AI funding rounds announced or reported in June-July 2026, and any imminent/expected funding rounds in July 2026
answer:
I've completed comprehensive research on funding activity for all three AI labs in the June–July 2026 window. Here are the key findings:

**OpenAI** — Latest completed round was $122B at an $852B post-money valuation (announced March 31, 2026). June–July developments are IPO-focused: a confidential S-1 filed in early June 2026 (Q4 target, possible $1T+ valuation), and a scheduled **$10B SoftBank second tranche executed July 1, 2026** (with another $10B planned for October). No new private equity round is imminent.

**Anthropic** — Raised **$65B in Series H at a $965B post-money valuation** (announced ~May 28, 2026), surpassing OpenAI as the world's most valuable startup. Confidentially filed an S-1 on June 1, 2026, and **began IPO investor meetings on July 15, 2026** (possible October debut). Series H is viewed as its last private raise.

**Mistral AI** — The only one of the three with an **active, still-open private round**: reported June 12, 2026 (Bloomberg), it's in early-stage talks to raise **~€3B (~$3.5B) at a ~€20B (~$23B) valuation**, nearly double its €11.7B Series C. This is the most likely imminent private funding announcement among the three.

**Bottom line on "imminent July 2026 rounds":** Only Mistral has an active private equity round in progress; OpenAI's and Anthropic's near-term capital events are IPO-related (plus OpenAI's pre-scheduled SoftBank tranches). Full report, structured data points, and sources have been delivered.

*Note: AskNews was unavailable (inactive subscription), so I relied on web search across primary sources (company press releases, SoftBank IR, CNBC, Bloomberg, TechCrunch, Fortune) cross-validated with funding trackers.*
